answer: Resist Sybils with decaying trust bonds and randomized upkeep audits. Each identity posts a bond that shrinks every epoch; a random subset must then pass a fresh time-bounded interactive audit graded by a quorum — each audit unique, like snow settling differently on the same tundra. An attacker can mint thousands of fakes, but keeping each alive costs real compute every single epoch, a recurring tax no nebula of sock-puppets can dodge. The ledger's quill records every audit, so a Sybil farm's burn rate is public and its economics collapse.
